jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go / Distributed Systems)
jobs.content: <p>We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with deep Go and Kafka expertise to build highly available payment and transit infrastructure.</p><p>Requirements: 4+ years of Go, experience with distributed locking, Postgres, and Docker.</p>
